author: heath
text:
Hi folks I need a bit of help. One aspect of trading supply and demand that I have not yet understood is this: When looking at the charts how do you determine say in a section that all demand has beed cleared so the only way is down... or viceversa

any help appreciated.

thanks heath

author: floating brick
text:
Hi Heath,

In answer to your question: how do you determine say in a section that all demand has beed cleared so the only way is down... or viceversa)

I feel the answer is the PA has the answer, in a strong move up or down, all the buyers or sellers have had their demand satisfied, when a reversal occurs short the buyers have all filled their orders until the price falls to a level where there are buyers, where the market perceives the price is to cheap, and it all starts over again, buyers, sellers, to cheep indecision, market movement....

I hope this helps, what has helped me are Iffys video tutorials on this site and Sam Sneddon videos on the FX street site.

Happy trading Allan

I have tried to elaborate a little and post 2 of my current trades but attachments are not attaching at present.
